style.prompt: Original fantasy creature character render for a premium creature-collecting game. Stylised but physically convincing 3D character, painterly cinematic finish. Three-quarter view facing slightly left, camera at the creature's eye level. Soft key light from upper left, cool rim light from behind right, soft ambient fill, subtle subsurface scattering on organic skin. Rich, species-appropriate surface detail with natural colour variation and fine imperfections. Elemental light effects are restrained and integrated into the anatomy. Full body in frame, centred, creature occupies about 80% of the frame height with even margin. Isolated on a fully transparent background, no ground, no scenery, no cast shadow, no text, no frame.
style.negative: no text, no watermark, no logo, no border, no background scenery, no ground plane, no cropping of limbs or tail, not a cartoon mascot, not low-poly, not pixel art, not anime, no extra heads, no duplicated limbs, no generic dragon unless specified

mossling.silhouette: Low, broad, rounded quadruped with a domed back and branching antlers rising above the head.
mossling.anatomy: Stocky body, short sturdy legs with three blunt toes, thick neck, short leafy tail.
mossling.face: Broad muzzle, large dark-green glossy eyes with gentle heavy lids, small nostrils.
mossling.posture: Calm, grounded, walking slowly forward with its head low and curious.
mossling.materials: Soft moss over pale bark-like skin, overlapping leaf shingles along the back, wooden antlers with fine grain.
mossling.effects: Tiny floating green spores and faint bioluminescent veins in the leaves.

stages.summary: A tiny, round sprout with soft moss and a single budding leaf on its head. It has only just begun to absorb the world around it.
stages.brief: Round, plush baby with an oversized head and huge eyes, stubby nub legs, one or two sprout leaves on top instead of antlers, soft pale-green moss fuzz, no leaf armour yet.

stages.summary: Its form takes shape: small antlers and leaves begin to grow, and its bond with the forest strengthens.
stages.brief: Small quadruped, still big-headed, first short branching antlers with a few leaves, first leaf shingles on shoulders, legs now visible, alert sitting pose.

stages.summary: A strong, sturdy body with full antlers and layered foliage, able to harness natural energy.
stages.brief: Mature broad body with layered leaf armour covering the back, full branching antlers, bark plating on legs, low powerful walking stance, longer leafy tail.

stages.summary: An ancient form: a living sanctuary with blossoming antlers and a radiant core of verdant energy.
stages.brief: Large, majestic, wide antlers like a small tree crown with glowing leaves and blossoms, moss and crystals growing from the back, bioluminescent green veins, slow regal stance, faint spores drifting.

driftfin.silhouette: Small streamlined fish that grows into a rising, curling sea dragon with flowing fins.
driftfin.anatomy: Legless, streamlined serpentine body tapering to a fan tail; pectoral fins near the head; no limbs.
driftfin.face: Narrow, pointed fish-dragon snout, round curious eyes, a single trailing barbel.
driftfin.posture: Swimming mid-water in a relaxed wave.
driftfin.materials: Smooth wet blue skin with pale belly, translucent membrane fins with fine rays.
driftfin.effects: Small glowing lateral-line dots and drifting bubbles.

stages.summary: A tiny tadpole-like swimmer with stubby fins and enormous eyes.
stages.brief: A tiny tadpole-like aquatic creature with an oversized head, tiny fins, a short tail and undeveloped anatomy. Big round curious eyes, soft translucent skin, no sail fin.

stages.summary: Its body lengthens and the first sail fin unfurls along its back.
stages.brief: A visibly larger juvenile with a longer body, developed pectoral fins, an emerging dorsal fin and more expressive features. Still juvenile proportions; first glowing lateral dots.

stages.summary: A fish-dragon with sweeping, flowing fins.
stages.brief: A substantially redesigned aquatic creature with a longer, more powerful body, flowing translucent fins, a developed dorsal crest and a clearly different silhouette from the juvenile. Fan tail, visible fin rays.

stages.summary: A tide-whisperer rising through the current on silken fins.
stages.brief: A majestic aquatic sea dragon with elaborate flowing fins, an extended tail, mature anatomy, intricate markings and sophisticated bioluminescence. Silk-like fin streamers, iridescent scales, regal pose.

pallow.silhouette: Floating radiant starburst: a single-eyed pearl core ringed by layered blade-petals.
pallow.anatomy: Limbless spherical body; feathers grow in uneven layered tiers like a flower opening; three long tail tassels.
pallow.face: One large serene eye in a pearly face plate, faint tear-like markings.
pallow.materials: Pearl core, layered ivory blade-petals with translucent edges.
pallow.effects: Soft dawn-coloured glow from within the pearl.

stages.summary: A small pearl with a fringe of down, one sleepy eye half open.
stages.brief: Small pearl orb, fuzzy down instead of feathers, eye half-closed, two short tassels, no feather fronds.

stages.summary: Its first feathers open in a loose ring around the pearl.
stages.brief: Pearl with one uneven ring of short soft feathers, eye fully open, three short tassels.

stages.summary: Layered fronds open like a flower and its tassels lengthen.
stages.brief: Two to three tiers of asymmetric layered feathers with translucent tips, long tassels with glowing ends, pearl face plate.

stages.summary: A herald of dawn, its feathers spread in a radiant crown.
stages.brief: Large crown of layered sweeping feathers in pearl, cream and pale blue, faint halo of light, very long tassels, ancient serene presence.

glimmeray.silhouette: Very wide flat manta ray seen from above at a slight angle, with a long whip tail.
glimmeray.anatomy: Broad triangular wings with a rippling trailing edge, two curled cephalic lobes, central ridge, whip tail.
glimmeray.face: Small round eyes on the sides of the head, gill spiracles behind them.
glimmeray.materials: Smooth light-blue skin with white spots on top, pale underside.
glimmeray.effects: Soft caustic light patterns over its back.

stages.summary: A tiny diamond-shaped glider with stubby wings and a short tail.
stages.brief: Small rounded diamond body, short wings, short tail, big eyes, a few faint spots.

stages.summary: Its wings widen and its first spot pattern appears.
stages.brief: Wider wings, longer tail, cephalic lobes beginning to curl, clear spot pattern.

stages.summary: A graceful manta with broad rippling wings and a long whip tail.
stages.brief: Full wide manta wings with rippling edges, long whip tail, fully curled lobes, crisp spot pattern.

stages.summary: A shallows guardian whose wings trail ribbons of light.
stages.brief: Very wide elegant wings with translucent trailing ribbons, iridescent spots, long tail with a glowing tip, caustic light across the back.

sproutwyrm.silhouette: Segmented inchworm in a high arch, with a flower-bud head.
sproutwyrm.anatomy: Bark-ringed round segments, small root-like legs on the grounded segments, budding shoots on top.
sproutwyrm.face: Small round eyes beneath a closed tulip-like petal hood, tiny mouth.
sproutwyrm.materials: Green bark rings with lichen, waxy petals, root tendrils.

stages.summary: A short, plump grub with a single green shoot.
stages.brief: Three or four plump segments, tiny root feet, one sprout on top, big eyes, no petal hood.

stages.summary: Its body lengthens and its first buds begin to swell.
stages.brief: Six to eight segments in a low arch, small buds on top, petal hood beginning to form.

stages.summary: A long arching wyrm with root legs and a full petal hood.
stages.brief: Eleven segments in a high arch, rooted legs, leafy shoots with glowing buds, closed tulip hood framing the face.

stages.summary: Its sprouts become branches and it rises as a leafy wyrm.
stages.brief: Large leafy wyrm with a raised head, branching antler-like growth, leaves along a segmented body, small root legs, glowing buds.

frostkit.silhouette: Compact low quadruped like a fox carved from ice, with a thick crystal tail.
frostkit.anatomy: Slender legs, angular crystalline plating over a soft frosty coat, tall crystal ears, ice spines along the back.
frostkit.face: Wedge-shaped snout, narrow ice-blue eyes, dark nose.
frostkit.materials: Frosted white fur with translucent refracting ice crystals.
frostkit.effects: Light refraction through the crystals; a little frost breath.

stages.summary: A fluffy white kit with tiny crystal nubs on its ears.
stages.brief: Round fluffy kit, big eyes, short legs, small crystal tips on the ears, fluffy tail.

stages.summary: The first ice spines push through its fur.
stages.brief: Leaner kit, short ice spines on the back, crystal ears, tail starting to crystallise.

stages.summary: A sleek crystal fox with a thick, faceted ice tail.
stages.brief: Elegant crystal-plated fox, tall ice ears, row of spines, thick translucent faceted tail, refracting light.

stages.summary: A glacier spirit trailing frozen light with every step.
stages.brief: Large regal ice fox with branching crystal crest, a flowing tail of many crystals, frost aura and snowflakes, prismatic refraction.

abyssal-vael.silhouette: Swan-necked ribbon serpent rising vertically out of its own coils.
abyssal-vael.anatomy: Coiled base, long elegant neck, narrow elongated head with a backswept crest, ribbon fins; no wings or legs.
abyssal-vael.face: Long narrow head, slit glowing cyan eyes.
abyssal-vael.posture: Rising and watchful, head angled down.
abyssal-vael.materials: Deep-blue smooth scales, translucent ribbon fins.

stages.summary: A small coiled serpentling with a short neck and a faint crest.
stages.brief: Small coil, short neck, large eyes, tiny crest bump, a few faint glowing veins.

stages.summary: Its neck lengthens and its first ribbon fins appear.
stages.brief: Neck rising higher, short ribbon fins at the tail, crest growing, clearer vein pattern.

stages.summary: An elegant serpent rising from its coils on a long, swan-like neck.
stages.brief: Full vertical S-neck, long backswept crest, trailing ribbon fins, glowing veins along the neck.

stages.summary: A solemn guardian of the trench, crowned with flowing light.
stages.brief: Very tall neck, multiple trailing ribbon fins like silk, crown-like crest, intense bioluminescent veins, deep-sea particles.

stormquill.silhouette: Crested storm bird with a dramatic crown of quills, growing into a griffin-like storm beast.
stormquill.anatomy: Strong bird body with sturdy legs and talons, broad wings, tail plumes with lightning bars.
stormquill.face: Hooked beak, round fierce eye under a strong brow.
stormquill.posture: Standing tall, chest out, wings half lifted.
stormquill.materials: Violet feathers with electric-cyan barbs, horn-coloured legs.
stormquill.effects: Small static sparks between the quill tips.

stages.summary: A fluffy round chick with a tuft of three quills.
stages.brief: Fluffy round violet chick, big eyes, three small crest quills, stubby legs.

stages.summary: A crested fledgling with its first quill crown.
stages.brief: Juvenile bird, fuller quill crest, small wings, first lightning barring on the tail.

stages.summary: A storm bird with a full crown of quills.
stages.brief: Strong storm bird, full spiky crest, broad wings half open, barred tail plumes, sparks between the quills.

stages.summary: Its crown crackles with captive lightning.
stages.brief: Majestic griffin-like storm bird, huge crest of long quills, wings spread, arcing lightning around it.

duskwing.silhouette: Moth with four broad eye-spotted wings and feathered antennae.
duskwing.anatomy: Furry thorax, segmented abdomen, four wings, feathery antennae, six small legs.
duskwing.face: Two large dark compound eyes, fuzzy face.
duskwing.materials: Velvet violet scales on the wings, fur on the body.
duskwing.effects: Eye-spots glow faintly in the dark.

stages.summary: A fuzzy caterpillar-moth with stubby wing buds.
stages.brief: Fluffy round larva-moth hybrid, tiny wing buds, short antennae, big eyes.

stages.summary: Its first small wings unfold, still crumpled.
stages.brief: Small soft crumpled wings, first eye-spots, longer antennae.

stages.summary: A velvet night moth with four broad eye-spotted wings.
stages.brief: Full four-winged moth, crisp eye-spots, feathered antennae, furry thorax.

stages.summary: A twilight sentinel whose wing-eyes watch the dark.
stages.brief: Large dramatic wings with long tails on the hindwings, glowing eye-spots, scalloped edges, dusk-coloured gradient, floating dust.

cryovant.silhouette: Floating crystal jellyfish: a faceted bell with hanging shard tendrils.
cryovant.anatomy: Faceted glass bell, rim of crystal points, chains of diamond shards, two ribbon arms.
cryovant.face: Two glowing orb eyes under the rim.
cryovant.materials: Clear and blue refractive crystal, frosted edges.
cryovant.effects: Inner glowing core and refracted caustics.

stages.summary: A tiny crystal bud with a few hanging shards.
stages.brief: Small rounded crystal bell, three short shard tendrils, big glowing eyes.

stages.summary: Its bell grows facets and its tendrils lengthen.
stages.brief: Larger faceted bell, five or six shard tendrils, faint core glow.

stages.summary: A crystal jellyfish with an intricate faceted bell.
stages.brief: Detailed faceted bell with rim crystals, many long shard chains, ribbon arms, bright core.

stages.summary: A lattice of living ice with a heart of light.
stages.brief: Large ornate crystalline bell with frost filigree, cascading shard chains like a chandelier, strong prismatic refraction.

emberlisk.silhouette: Spiked lava lizard on four legs, growing a jagged ridge of molten spines.
emberlisk.anatomy: Chunky lizard body, sturdy legs with claws, ridge of jagged dorsal spines, thick tail.
emberlisk.face: Wide jaw, slit amber eyes, glowing nostrils.
emberlisk.materials: Dark violet basalt-like armour with molten orange seams, warm glowing belly.
emberlisk.effects: Heat shimmer and embers rising from the seams.

stages.summary: A small round lizard with warm glowing spots.
stages.brief: Small chubby lizard, big eyes, tiny bumps along the back, glowing orange spots.

stages.summary: Its first spines push up along its back.
stages.brief: Young lizard with a row of small spines, first lava cracks.

stages.summary: A spiked lava lizard with a molten ridge.
stages.brief: Strong lizard, tall jagged spine ridge with molten edges, cracked dark hide.

stages.summary: A kiln-hearted titan whose spines glow like forge iron.
stages.brief: Massive lava lizard, huge jagged flaming spines, glowing cracks, embers and heat haze.

neonyx.silhouette: Deep-sea angler-wyrm: rounded body, gaping glowing maw and a lantern lure on a stalk.
neonyx.anatomy: Bulbous body, frilled dorsal fins, fan tail, side fins, lure stalk from the forehead.
neonyx.face: Small glowing eye, huge mouth with neon teeth.
neonyx.materials: Dark velvet skin with neon photophores.

stages.summary: A tiny round fry with a glowing dot on a short stalk.
stages.brief: Small round fry, big eye, tiny lure dot, small fins, mouth closed.

stages.summary: Its lure grows and its first photophores light up.
stages.brief: Rounder body, longer lure stalk, a few photophores, small teeth.

stages.summary: An angler-wyrm with a gaping neon maw and lantern lure.
stages.brief: Full body, frilled fins, open glowing maw, bright lantern lure, rows of photophores.

stages.summary: A living lantern, brighter the longer it is held.
stages.brief: Large ornate angler with multiple lures, flowing frills, intricate neon patterns, glowing particles.

aurorath.silhouette: Sky whale trailing curtains of aurora beneath its belly.
aurorath.anatomy: Massive whale body, long pectoral fins, flukes, throat grooves.
aurorath.face: Small kind eye, long mouth line.
aurorath.materials: Teal skin with aurora bands, pale throat grooves.

stages.summary: A round calf with stubby fins and a faint shimmer.
stages.brief: Round whale calf, stubby fins, small faint aurora shimmer, big kind eye.

stages.summary: Its first thin aurora veils begin to trail.
stages.brief: Longer calf, two or three thin aurora veils, longer fins.

stages.summary: A sky whale trailing curtains of aurora light.
stages.brief: Large whale, full curtains of green and violet aurora hanging below, aurora bands on the back.

stages.summary: Where it passes, the sky remembers colour.
stages.brief: Enormous majestic sky whale, flowing aurora curtains and streamers, starlit skin, gentle light rays.

zephrax.silhouette: Long Eastern storm dragon whose serpentine body coils through billowing storm clouds.
zephrax.anatomy: Sinuous scaled body with four small clawed legs, flowing mane and whiskers, crystal-blue dorsal spines, cloud-wrapped tail.
zephrax.face: Long horned dragon head, slit yellow eyes, flowing whiskers.
zephrax.posture: Rising in a coil through the clouds, head raised.
zephrax.materials: Pearl-white and storm-blue scales, ice-blue crystal spines, soft volumetric cloud.
zephrax.effects: Small lightning arcs inside the clouds.

stages.summary: A small cloud serpent curled in a puff of storm vapour.
stages.brief: Short curled serpent with big eyes and tiny horn nubs, wrapped in a small cloud puff, a spark at the tail tip.

stages.summary: Its body lengthens and its first mane and spines grow.
stages.brief: Longer S-shaped serpent, short mane, small blue spines, little legs, cloud trailing from the tail.

stages.summary: A storm dragon coiling through billowing clouds.
stages.brief: Long coiled dragon among large clouds, full mane and whiskers, crystal spines, lightning flickering in the clouds.

stages.summary: An upright storm dragon rising from the clouds, crackling with lightning.
stages.brief: Majestic upright storm dragon rising from a cloud bank, tall crystal spines, long horns, crackling lightning, flowing mane.

prismara.silhouette: Tall crowned bird displaying a peacock-like fan of prism shards.
prismara.anatomy: Slender upright body, thin legs, small crowned head, fan tail of crystal shards.

stages.summary: A small chick with a single shard feather.
stages.brief: Small chick, one crystal shard on the tail, tiny crown bump.

stages.summary: Its first shards grow into a small fan.
stages.brief: Juvenile with a small fan of five shards, crown forming.

stages.summary: A crowned bird with a full fan of prism shards.
stages.brief: Tall slender bird, full fan of crystal shards, three-point crown, refracted light.

stages.summary: Light that enters Prismara never leaves the same colour.
stages.brief: Majestic queen with a huge layered shard fan, jewelled crown, spectral rainbow refraction.

aurelion.silhouette: Winged golden lion-dragon standing on four legs, with great feathered-membrane wings raised.
aurelion.anatomy: Powerful leonine body, clawed paws, long tail with a tuft, large wings, crown of swept horns, mane of golden plates.
aurelion.face: Proud lion-dragon face, fierce almond eyes, short snout.
aurelion.posture: Standing tall on four legs, wings raised.
aurelion.materials: Gold scale armour over a pale-gold coat, filigree on the wings.
aurelion.effects: Soft golden light and drifting motes.

stages.summary: A small golden whelp curled up with its wing nubs folded.
stages.brief: Small round golden whelp lying curled, big eyes, tiny wing nubs, soft gold fuzz.

stages.summary: A golden cub with small wings and its first horns.
stages.brief: Lion-dragon cub standing, small feathered wings, short horns, first scale plates.

stages.summary: A winged golden lion-dragon with a crown of horns.
stages.brief: Mature winged lion-dragon on four legs, large raised wings, mane of golden plates, crown of horns.

stages.summary: Sovereign of the Gilded Slot, with vast ornate wings and a towering crown.
stages.brief: Huge regal lion-dragon, enormous ornate wings, filigreed gold armour, tall crown, golden light.

solvanth.silhouette: Leviathan coiled around a captive sun.
solvanth.anatomy: Long serpentine body wrapping an orb, maned head rising above it, fins along the coil.
solvanth.face: Long maned head, slit red eyes.

stages.summary: A small serpent curled around a glowing ember.
stages.brief: Small golden serpent curled around a small ember orb, big eyes.

stages.summary: It grows around a brightening sun-seed.
stages.brief: Longer serpent wrapping a brighter orb, short mane.

stages.summary: A leviathan coiled around a captive sun.
stages.brief: Large coil around a blazing sun orb, full mane, fins along the coil.

stages.summary: It circles the sun once per epoch.
stages.brief: Massive leviathan, multiple coils, radiant corona, flame mane, regal head.

pyraurum.silhouette: Golden phoenix in full flight trailing flame streamers.
pyraurum.anatomy: Sleek body, raised wings, long flame tail plumes, crested head.
pyraurum.materials: Gold and orange feathers with fire edges.

stages.summary: A downy golden chick with a single flame feather.
stages.brief: Round downy chick, small flame tuft, big eyes.

stages.summary: Its wings grow and its first flame plumes appear.
stages.brief: Juvenile phoenix, short wings, two flame tail plumes.

stages.summary: A golden phoenix in flight, trailing fire.
stages.brief: Full phoenix in flight, raised wings, long flame streamers, crest.

stages.summary: It burns, falls and rises again, brighter each time.
stages.brief: Majestic phoenix with huge flaming wings, flowing fire tail, ember storm, ornate crest.

aurelith.silhouette: Ancient sea turtle carrying a gilded, inlaid shell.
aurelith.anatomy: Domed shell with hex scutes, large front flippers, wise head.
aurelith.materials: Gold shell with inlaid glowing patterns, weathered skin.

stages.summary: A small hatchling turtle with a soft golden shell.
stages.brief: Tiny turtle with a soft rounded shell, big eyes, small flippers.

stages.summary: Its shell hardens and its first gold inlay appears.
stages.brief: Juvenile turtle, defined scutes, faint gold inlay.

stages.summary: An ancient sea turtle with a gilded shell.
stages.brief: Large turtle, ornate gold hex inlay, big flippers, wise face.

stages.summary: Its shadow turns oceans to molten gold.
stages.brief: Colossal turtle with a shell like a temple roof, glowing runes, barnacle jewels, slow majestic swim.

velynx.silhouette: Sleek, upright feline with very long swept-back pointed ears and a long tail that curls up behind it in a graceful S-curve.
velynx.anatomy: Lean agile body, slim digitigrade hind legs, slender forelimbs, narrow waist, cheek tufts, long tapering tail ending in a teal leaf-shaped tip.
velynx.face: Compact feline face with a small muzzle, large almond eyes with violet irises ringed in turquoise, a knowing half-smile.
velynx.posture: Standing poised and light on its toes, weight on one leg, head slightly tilted — confident and a little mischievous.
velynx.materials: Matte charcoal-to-obsidian fur with a subtle satin sheen, smooth teal pads on the paws, inner ears in deep teal.
velynx.effects: Refined cyan bioluminescent glyph markings that trace the chest, limbs and tail like living circuitry; faint violet energy only in the final form. No emblem or logo on the tail.

stages.summary: A small, dark, round kitten with short ears and huge eyes; its first cyan glyphs are only just appearing.
stages.brief: A small, dark, round-bodied juvenile with short rounded ears, oversized expressive violet-and-turquoise eyes, tiny teal paws and a short tail. Faint cyan markings are just beginning to appear as a few dots on the chest. Sitting, curious.

stages.summary: A small, agile young feline: its ears grow pointed, its tail lengthens and its cyan glyphs light up.
stages.brief: A small agile feline with developing pointed ears, a longer curling tail, visible cyan markings on chest and legs and juvenile proportions (large head, slim limbs). Light, playful standing pose.

stages.summary: Lean and athletic, with long ears, intricate luminous glyphs and a confident stance.
stages.brief: A lean, athletic creature with mature proportions, long swept-back ears, intricate cyan glyph markings over chest, arms, legs and tail, a long developed S-curved tail with a teal tip, and a confident upright posture.

stages.summary: The Glyphwalker: elegant extended ears, cyan and violet glyphs and controlled elemental energy.
stages.brief: The ultimate legendary form: exceptionally refined anatomy, elegant extended ears with luminous edges, elaborate cyan and violet glyph markings, a sophisticated tail with fin-like vanes and floating glyph rings, and controlled cyan and violet energy around the paws. Regal, poised, mysterious.

nyxara.silhouette: Slender, low-slung fox-like creature with very long upswept ears and a single long ribbon tail that loops through the air behind it.
nyxara.anatomy: Narrow chest, long slim legs, fine pointed muzzle, ear membranes like dusk-coloured silk, and a tail that thins into a flat flowing ribbon rather than a brush.
nyxara.face: Narrow fox face, small dark nose, large golden almond eyes with a calm, sly look.
nyxara.posture: Mid-step and turning its head back over its shoulder, as if it has only just noticed you.
nyxara.materials: Velvety indigo fur grading to violet, pale lavender chest fur, translucent violet ribbon membrane with a soft sheen.
nyxara.effects: Faint dusk-light along the ribbon edge and ear tips; small drifting violet motes. Distinct from Velynx: no glyph circuitry, no upright cat stance, no teal.

stages.summary: A tiny curled-up indigo kit with oversized ears and a short stub of ribbon for a tail.
stages.brief: A small, round indigo kit lying curled with its oversized soft ears folded back, big golden eyes, short legs tucked under and a short ribbon-stub tail wrapped around its body.

stages.summary: A gangly young fox standing on long legs, ears upright, ribbon tail beginning to flow.
stages.brief: A slim juvenile fox standing alert on long thin legs, large upright ears, a ribbon tail as long as its body with a faint glowing edge, and an inquisitive tilted head.

stages.summary: A sleek dusk fox mid-stride, head turned back, its ribbon tail looping through the air.
stages.brief: A sleek adult in mid-stride looking back over its shoulder, long upswept ears with silk membranes, a long looping ribbon tail with a glowing edge, lavender chest ruff.

stages.summary: The Ribbon of Dusk: twin ribbon tails, crescent-tipped ears and a veil of drifting twilight.
stages.brief: The ascended form: elongated crescent-tipped ears, two long ribbon tails weaving a figure-eight, a pale twilight mane, a crescent mark on the brow and a soft veil of violet motes trailing behind it.

thalor.silhouette: Massive deep-sea guardian fish-beast with a heavy armoured head shield, layered fan fins and a powerful crescent tail.
thalor.anatomy: Thick torpedo body, a broad helmet-like head plate with brow ridges, overlapping armour bands along the back, three layered dorsal fins, long pectoral fins and a strong forked tail.
thalor.face: Deep-set pale eyes under a heavy brow, a broad jaw with short tusks, calm and watchful.
thalor.posture: Hovering forward with slow authority, head lowered like a shield.
thalor.materials: Deep teal and ocean-blue hide, pale sea-glass belly, armour plates with a nacre sheen, translucent cyan fin membranes.
thalor.effects: Bioluminescent cyan lines along the armour seams and fin rays; small rising bubbles. Distinct from Driftfin: heavy, armoured and broad rather than a slender eel.

stages.summary: A round armoured fry with a tiny shield of a head plate and stubby fins.
stages.brief: A small round fry with a big head wearing a tiny shell-like brow plate, big pale eyes, stubby fan fins and a short tail; a few bioluminescent freckles.

stages.summary: A sturdy young swimmer: the head plate widens and the first dorsal fin rises.
stages.brief: A sturdy juvenile with a widening helmet plate, a single dorsal fin, developed pectoral fins, a forked tail and first armour bands along its back.

stages.summary: A deep-sea guardian with a broad helmet, layered fins and glowing armour seams.
stages.brief: A powerful adult with a broad armoured head shield, overlapping back plates, three layered dorsal fins, long pectorals, a strong crescent tail and glowing cyan seam lines.

stages.summary: The Deepwarden: crowned helmet, cathedral fins and a tail like a breaking wave.
stages.brief: The ascended form: a crowned helmet with swept-back horn ridges, towering layered dorsal fins like cathedral spires, tusks, trailing fin streamers, a huge crescent tail and a slow ring of light around it.
